verdict.rationale: Quo's own Sona AI agent works autonomously in the background: it answers calls when the team can't, captures details and hands off. That is a narrow, product-defined autonomous behavior rather than a general automation builder. Webhooks and the API are only developer building blocks, and the MCP connectors are interactive chat use, so neither earns credit here. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder, triggers or schedules for background runs, documentation of how Sona is set up or customized, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
